skill.description: Read Linear project lists and project details from the CLI using a Linear API key.
skill.summary: Read-only CLI access for listing Linear projects and inspecting project details.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: The Linear API key and .env handling findings are confirmed because the skill requires a credential and documents hidden environment file use. Most backtick alerts are Markdown false positives, but documented Bun commands do execute local scripts and should remain reviewable; no prompt-injection attempt was found.

remediation.suggestion: Document the minimum required Linear token permissions and warn users not to use broad personal tokens when a scoped token is available.
Avoid scanning parent directories for .env files, and document the exact secret lookup order so users know which credential is used.
Publish the referenced command implementation with the skill, pin dependencies, and validate command arguments before calling Linear.
Tell users that project data is printed to the terminal and should only be piped to trusted tools or files.

content.user_title: Read Linear Projects from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need quick visibility into Linear projects without opening the web app. This skill runs read-only CLI commands to list projects and inspect details.
actual_capabilities: Lists Linear projects from the command line.
Filters project lists by project lead name.
Limits the number of returned projects.
Retrieves one project by UUID or partial project name.
Supports table output and JSON output modes.
limitations: Requires Bun and a LINEAR_API_KEY before commands can run.
Only supports read-only project operations documented by the skill.
Does not manage Linear issues, cycles, teams, or comments.
Depends on the referenced local command files being installed correctly.

use_cases.title: Review Active Project Work
use_cases.description: List started projects and inspect ownership before a planning meeting.

use_cases.title: Check Product Delivery Status
use_cases.description: Find projects by lead or status and review details without leaving the terminal.

use_cases.title: Create Project Status Reports
use_cases.description: Export project data in JSON format for trusted reporting tools.

prompt_templates.title: List Recent Projects
prompt_templates.prompt: List up to 10 Linear projects and show the terminal output directly.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show Linear projects with status started. Do not summarize the table unless I ask.

prompt_templates.title: Find Projects by Lead
prompt_templates.prompt: List Linear projects led by Jordan Lee and return JSON output for downstream filtering.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Specific Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the Linear project matching the name Platform Migration and include JSON output for audit notes.

output_examples.input: List started Linear projects with a limit of 10.
output_examples.output: A terminal table showing matching projects, including project names, status, lead, and related details.

output_examples.input: Get the project named Platform Migration.
output_examples.output: A focused project detail view for the best matching Linear project.

output_examples.input: List projects led by Jordan Lee in JSON mode.
output_examples.output: Machine-readable project records suitable for a trusted report or local filter.

best_practices: Use the least privileged Linear API key available for project reads.
Run JSON output only in trusted terminals, scripts, and storage locations.
Confirm project name matches when using partial project names.
anti_patterns: Do not use a broad personal API token when a scoped token is available.
Do not pipe project data into untrusted tools or shared logs.
Do not assume partial project names always select the intended project.

faq.question: Does this skill change Linear data?
faq.answer: No. The documented commands are read-only and cover listing projects or getting one project.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: The skill requires LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or in the documented .env location.

faq.question: Can it filter project lists?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents filters for project status, project lead name, and result limit.

faq.question: Can it return JSON output?
faq.answer: Yes. Both list and get commands document a JSON output option.

faq.question: Does it support partial project names?
faq.answer: Yes. The get command supports case-insensitive partial project name matching.

faq.question: Which tools can use this marketplace listing?
faq.answer: The listing declares compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
